statement: ∀ (a : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → (∑' i : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (a * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(i : ℤ)-1))) = ENNReal.ofReal a
proof:
intro a ha
have he (i : ℕ) : a * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(i : ℤ)-1) = a / 2 / 2 ^ i := by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
  norm_num
  ring
simp_rw [he]
rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg (fun i => by positivity) (summable_geometric_two' a), tsum_geometric_two']
